ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and family. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between family and your image. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between money and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1799009821000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.
